description: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics helps authorized users discover data views, dimensions, metrics, segments, date ranges, projects, and audiences; run ranked CJA reports; inspect component definitions; and create or update reusable CJA components and Workspace projects through ChatGPT. It requires Adobe IMS OAuth and Customer Journey Analytics product access, and tool calls use the signed-in user's IMS organization, sandbox or product context, and CJA permissions.
